head: ngan
rule: งาน is the plainest head yet: 23 of the 27 real compounds are sense 1 and need no argument. What matters is what is NOT sense 1. Sense 2 takes only words naming an OCCASION people gather for — งานศพ, its euphemism งานขาวดำ, and แต่งงาน, which is 'to dress the occasion'. Sense 4 takes พลังงาน alone, because energy is defined as the capacity to do work in exactly the physics sense the RID gives there. งานช้าง looks like an occasion and is not: the dictionary's second gloss is a job needing great investment and effort, so it stays at 1. Sense 3, the area measure of 100 square wah, takes NOTHING — a unit on every land document in the country has produced no compound at all.
